capabilities: Compare the current note against any Markdown baseline file with inline addition/deletion marks
Restore or save selected deleted passages, including to their original location
Detect and jump between likely moved paragraphs
Save selected text to a scratchpad file for later reuse
Rewrite selected prose via Codex CLI or DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not refactor code or restructure notes; it overlays a diff between two Markdown drafts.
extras: Desktop only (macOS and Windows; Linux untested), requires Obsidian 1.13.0+, has a detailed privacy section, release attestations via GitHub Actions, and a full Chinese-language README duplicate.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compare two drafts of a note inline and selectively recover deleted text while continuing to edit.

relations.evidence: OpenAI Codex CLI | codex. Leave the model ID blank to use Codex's own configuration
DeepSeek Harness CLI | dsh. Leave the model ID blank to use the Harness headless configuration.

requires.name: Codex CLI or DeepSeek Harness CLI

summary: Inline Markdown draft-comparison lens that shows additions, deletions and moved paragraphs in the editor, with deletion restore, a scratchpad, and optional AI rewriting.
